name: setu
description: Setu (সেতু) — AI SME Finance Copilot (simulated sandbox)

scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory services/agent alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: uv run --directory services/agent python -m seed.cli seed
scripts.db:reset-demo: uv run --directory services/agent python -m seed.cli reset-demo
scripts.kb:sync: uv run --directory services/agent python -m app.rag.cli sync
scripts.kb:index: uv run --directory services/agent python -m app.rag.cli index
scripts.dev:agent: uv run --directory services/agent fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && uv run --directory services/agent ruff check . && uv run --directory services/agent ruff format --check .
scripts.format: pnpm --dir apps/web format && uv run --directory services/agent ruff format . && uv run --directory services/agent ruff check --fix .
scripts.test: uv run --directory services/agent pytest -q && pnpm --dir apps/web test
